note: Two levels: L1 groups, L2 categories. Every entity gets exactly one L2 (IS_A ProductType -> IN Category). priority marks the four priority groups of PLAN_PRODUCTS_V1.md decision 9. Descriptions are boundary rules for labelling, not marketing copy. ProductType (below L2) carries the fine type, e.g. 'Má phanh ô tô', 'Lọc gió', 'Groupset'.
